components.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
components.feature: topic->video-copy pipeline, material search, subtitle/BGM, task mgmt, provider abstraction
components.notes: MIT. We study the pipeline/provider-abstraction patterns only; no code copied.

components.name: whisperX
components.feature: word-level timestamps, forced alignment, sentence boundaries
components.notes: Older docs mention BSD-4-Clause; current repo is BSD-2. Optional dep behind AlignmentProvider. Phase 1-B.

components.name: auto-editor
components.feature: silence detection, dead-space removal, audio-based cutting, cut margins
components.notes: Code is public domain. We implement the silence/margin algorithm ideas in our Edit Engine. Phase 1-B.

components.name: PySceneDetect
components.feature: scene cut / transition detection in existing footage
components.notes: BSD-3. Used to avoid cutting across existing shot boundaries. Phase 1-B.

components.name: Remotion
components.notes: Free for individuals / for-profit orgs with <=3 employees. 4+ employees need a paid Company License ($25/seat/mo creators, or $0.01/render automators, $100/mo min). Decide FFmpeg-only vs Remotion before Phase 1-B render work.

components.name: Real-ESRGAN
components.notes: Repo code BSD-3, but bundled pretrained weights depend on datasets with their own terms (e.g. some GAN weights). Verify weight provenance before commercial use. Phase 1-B, quality-gated.

components.name: RIFE (ECCV2022-RIFE)
components.feature: video frame interpolation for low-FPS generated clips
components.notes: Code MIT; README historically restricts some pretrained models to non-commercial / training-data terms. Confirm model weights license before commercial use. Phase 1-B, QA-before/after gated.

components.name: blader/humanizer
components.feature: agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing
components.notes: MIT. We analyse the tell-list / approach for our Natural Writing Engine but do NOT copy its prompts verbatim (Amendment §4).

components.name: edge-tts
components.feature: free Microsoft Edge read-aloud TTS for dev/test
components.notes: LGPL-3 code is fine, but it calls Microsoft Edge's online TTS with no Azure subscription; commercial use may violate Microsoft ToS. DEV/TEST TTSProvider candidate only, never the production default (Amendment §16).
